players.product: OSAT (incl. JCET STATS ChipPAC Korea) - package substrate buyer from Simmtech and Daeduck Electronics

quarterly_data.signal: Capex budget raised (Q3 results release): the board has approved an increase in the 2026 capital expenditure budget from RMB 9.98 billion to RMB 17.31 billion; the company says it directs capex toward advanced packaging technologies and the expansion of advanced manufacturing capacity.
quarterly_data.figure: 2026 capex budget RMB 17.31 billion (raised from RMB 9.98 billion)
quarterly_data.quarter: JCET press release: Building Out Advanced Packaging Portfolio, JCET Delivers (10-22-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Sequential growth (Q3 results release): Q3 2026 revenue rose 10.3% from the previous quarter and net profit attributable to shareholders (RMB 770 million) 39.4% from the previous quarter; the company says the 2.3-point YoY gross-margin gain in the first nine months came mainly from a more favorable product mix across its sites in China and overseas.
quarterly_data.figure: Q3 2026 revenue +10.3% QoQ; net profit attributable +39.4% QoQ
quarterly_data.quarter: JCET press release: Building Out Advanced Packaging Portfolio, JCET Delivers (10-22-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Technology programs (Q3 results release): JCET is working with multiple customers (not named) on joint development of glass substrate and panel-level packaging technologies, with the related programs now progressing to pilot-line construction; in co-packaged optics it has built PIC-EIC heterogeneous integration capability on its XDFOI platform and has developed the capability to co-package optical engines with switching and computing chips (capability only, no volume stated).
quarterly_data.quarter: JCET press release: Building Out Advanced Packaging Portfolio, JCET Delivers (10-22-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Sites (Q3 results release): JCET Microelectronics (Jiangyin), which specialises in high-end advanced packaging, kept expanding capacity in the first nine months and the new Shanghai high-end advanced packaging project progressed steadily; the South Korea site is accelerating the introduction of high-end advanced packaging programs for leading global wafer manufacturers and AI customers (not named), and the Singapore site is rapidly shifting its business mix toward higher-value applications including data centers. The Computing Electronics business mainly serves computing, memory, interconnect and power solutions used in AI data center infrastructure.
